name: Evelyn C. Rysdyk
reason: No usable photo: the only photo of her on her own site (evelynrysdyk.com/images/evelyn.jpg) is 194 x 285 px, under the 300 px minimum, and every other source was closed to us on 4 Nov 2026: her main site spiritpassages.com did not accept the connection (not retried), simonandschuster.com.au returned 403, redwheelweiser.com's robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai, and she has no YouTube channel we could find. Otherwise she looked listable: evelynrysdyk.com (no robots.txt) publishes a base (Yarmouth, Maine), an email (passages@maine.rr.com), names The Shift Network on theauthor.html, and offers seven free guided-journey and meditation MP3s; her books could not be confirmed because Open Library refused the connection. Worth a re-run if spiritpassages.com comes back or a larger photo turns up.
